description: Hourly joined feature feed combining FMI meteorological forecasts (wind speed, gusts, global solar radiation, cloud cover, temperature, heating degree hours across Finnish wind/solar/demand hubs) with Fingrid wind, solar, and electricity consumption forecasts and actuals. Includes 1h wind/residual ramps, storm cut-out flags, and EV smart-charging rankings. Uses NO Nord Pool or ENTSO-E day-ahead prices.
name: fmi_fingrid_nowcast
title: FMI Weather + Fingrid Wind/Solar/Consumption Nowcast Feed
